decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-37 MODIFY recording graduated orange for GLOBAL and the strapline and black for DOUGH; no additional update or removal is needed.
The existing message-37 MODIFY already records the approved graduated-orange strapline treatment, while the source decision does not alter the retained side-line treatment.
The approved main-logo colour treatment does not change which colour-variant files must be delivered; the candidate's message-37 requirement remains valid unchanged.
Approving the logo's colour treatment does not modify the independent obligation to provide complementary font guidance.
The colour specification does not alter any approved letterform dimensions or features; the same message's final-version approval is already represented separately in this candidate's history.
The candidate already records rev8-11 as the composition baseline from message 37, and the colour-specification update requires no further composition attribute change.
The approved colour allocation does not modify the flame-based O or its recognition requirement.
The source specifies the strapline's colour but does not change the independent requirement that the existing strapline be included.
The colour treatment does not change the company name, exclusion of the word 'truck', or the intended breadth of the brand representation.
The approved colours do not modify the candidate's character direction or constraint against excessive ornamentation.
The final colour selection does not retroactively change the completed concept-development obligations or the inspiration-only role of the reference material.
Selecting a colour treatment does not alter the requirement for original artwork or the inspiration-only status of the AI-generated draft.
